title: Vietnam Era Museum and Education Center

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: A guided tour of the Memorial and Museum offers visitors of all ages unique opportunities to hear first-hand accounts and perspectives about the Vietnam War and Era. Tours are available for adult, college, youth, and scout groups and can be customized to include just the Memorial, the Museum, or both, tailored to fit each group’s needs. Led by Vietnam Veteran tour guides, these group tours offer a unique opportunity to hear firsthand accounts and personal perspectives on the Vietnam War and Era.
